INVERSION: containedIn points up (this file names its archive), hasPart points down. The value is not written on this node -- it selects the distribution whose @id it names, and this node is appended to that distribution's schema:hasPart. CDIF has no schema:isPartOf building block, so hasPart on the container is the available direction.
